name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Earrings
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - This product is made from high-quality natural wood with a thickness of approximately 3mm per layer. 
    - The puzzle features a sturdy 2-layer wooden structure, ensuring durability, a smooth surface, and a premium handcrafted feel.
    - Finished with durable metal components, including earring hooks and connecting rings, available in silver or gold color options.
    - Smooth edges and comfortable for long-term wear.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Earring size (WxH): 1.5 x 1.5 inches ~ 3.81 x 3.81 cm.
    - Earring hook length: 2 cm
    - Metal ring diameter: 0.8 cm
    - Designed to be eye-catching while remaining lightweight and easy to wear.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology. Printed on both sides, ensuring a beautiful appearance from every angle and a premium finished look.
    - Delivers sharp, vivid, and long-lasting colors with excellent detail.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Perfect as fashion accessories for daily wear, parties, festivals, or themed events.
    - Lightweight wooden design makes them comfortable for all-day use.
    - Custom shapes and designs allow for personalization, branding, or seasonal themes.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and stylish gift for women, teens, and fashion lovers of all ages.
    - Suitable for any occasion, including holidays, birthdays, Valentine’s Day, St. Patrick’s Day, Christmas, anniversaries, or special celebrations.
    - Can be paired with an optional gift box (available in red, black, or white) for a complete gift-ready presentation.
     

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Earrings

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
